g.text: Seed 23 | 500 optimizer updates | 16 x 16 grids | Channel 0 at tick 20
Training record u is plotted at k = u - 1; probe checkpoints are plotted after their stated update.
All 500 training records and 11 saved evaluations are shown. Probe connectors guide the eye;
intermediate probe accuracy was not measured. Curves are one seed, with no smoothing or uncertainty bands.
